symptom: `mxcli check -p` passed scripts with user-task features the project's version cannot store, and exec wrote them: group targeting below 11.2 (CE1859 on 10.24, the targeting emptied by mx convert), and multi-user task rules and `await all users` below the version that introduced them. Once the user task was lowered to its pre-10.12 shape, these were refused only at write time, part-way through a script
cause: statementVersionGates had no gate for anything inside a workflow user task. The generated version data floors properties, never types, and the rule types (MajorityCompletionCriteria, ThresholdCompletionCriteria 10.0; MicroflowCompletionCriteria 10.3), the group targetings (11.2) and the multi-user task itself (UserTaskCompletion 9.22) are type-level introductions
file: `mdl/executor/version_gates.go` (userTaskGates, called from the CreateWorkflowStmt and AlterWorkflowStmt cases); `sdk/versions/mendix-9|10|11.yaml` (workflows.multi_user_task 9.22.0, multi_user_task_majority_threshold 10.0.0, multi_user_task_await_all 10.2.0, multi_user_task_microflow_rule 10.3.0, group_targeting 11.2.0)
insight: **A write-time refusal is the last line, not the check.** canon.LowerToProjectShape refuses what the older shape cannot hold, but by then the statements before it are written. Each such refusal wants a matching MDL-VERSION01 gate, so `check -p` reports it and exec refuses the script before writing anything ('Refusing to execute: 4 error(s) above. Nothing was written.' on 9.24.30). **Gate the clause, not the statement**: a workflow with a consensus or veto multi-user task is fine from 9.22, so the gates walk the activities (create, and every activity alter workflow inserts) and fire only for a rule, a targeting kind or `await all users` the version lacks. **Read the type floors from mendixmodelsdk's StructureVersionInfo** (gen/workflows.js; text-extract it, never execute it). The generated version.go has no row for a type. Measured with the bug-test: check -p on 9.24.30 reports WF_Majority (10.0), WF_Await (10.2), WF_Microflow (10.3) and WF_Groups (11.2). 10.24.24 reports WF_Groups only. 11.13.0 reports none, exec writes all five, and mx check gives 0 errors. Control: TestCheckVersionGates_UserTaskFeatures failed for every case before the gates. Tests: TestCheckVersionGates_UserTaskFeatures, …AtTheirFloors; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1771-user-task-features-by-version.mdl
